title: A semilocal Dedekind domain reduces to finitely many DVRs
statement: Let B be a semilocal Dedekind domain (a Noetherian integrally closed domain of Krull dimension 1 [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]) with fraction field K. The set of maximal ideals of B is finite, and replacing B by the finite family of localizations B_m at its maximal ideals produces discrete valuation rings [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] with fraction field K. An element of K lies in the Jacobson radical of B exactly when its image lies in the maximal ideal of every B_m.

source.place: Algebra Definition 034W and Lemma 034X (algebra-lemma-characterize-Dedekind), together with the localization description at maximal ideals used in Varieties Lemma 09N5

proof.text: Because B is semilocal, its set of maximal ideals is finite. Since B is a one-dimensional domain, every maximal ideal is a nonzero prime ideal.

source.place: Algebra Definition 034W (algebra-definition-Dedekind), semilocal reduction used in Varieties Lemma 09N5

proof.text: For each maximal ideal m, the localization B_m is a discrete valuation ring by [lem-sc-dedekind-localization-dvr], applied to the nonzero prime m. The canonical embedding B_m into the fraction field K identifies the fraction field of B_m with K: every element of K is a quotient of elements of B, hence also of elements of B_m, while B_m is a subring of K.

source.place: Algebra Lemma 034X (algebra-lemma-characterize-Dedekind), localization at a nonzero prime

proof.text: Let x be in K. If x is in the Jacobson radical of B, then x is in every maximal ideal m of B and hence its image is in the maximal ideal of every B_m. Conversely, if the image of x is in the maximal ideal of every B_m, then x is in every B_m, so the intersection assertion of [lem-sc-dedekind-intersection-localizations] gives x in B; its contraction assertion then gives x in every maximal ideal m. Thus x is in the Jacobson radical of B exactly when its image lies in the maximal ideal of every B_m.

lean.statement: theorem semilocal_dedekind_dvr_reduction (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B] [Finite (MaximalSpectrum B)] (hdim : ringKrullDim B = 1) (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra B K] [IsFractionRing B K] : let a := fun m : MaximalSpectrum B => IsLocalization.localizationAlgebraOfSubmonoidLe (Localization.AtPrime m.asIdeal) K m.asIdeal.primeCompl (nonZeroDivisors B) m.asIdeal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors Finite (MaximalSpectrum B) ∧ (∀ m : MaximalSpectrum B, letI := a m IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime m.asIdeal) ∧ IsFractionRing (Localization.AtPrime m.asIdeal) K) ∧ (∀ x : K, (∃ b : B, b ∈ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal B) ∧ algebraMap B K b = x) ↔ ∀ m : MaximalSpectrum B, letI := a m ∃ y : Localization.AtPrime m.asIdeal, y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime m.asIdeal) ∧ algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime m.asIdeal) K y = x)
